cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate. MongoDB wants 1 GB or more

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

version.desc: Major version. MongoDB 8 does not start on Linux kernel 6.19 and newer (MongoDB issue SERVER-121912); use 7 there. Upgrade one major version at a time; downgrades of existing data do not work

rootuser.desc: Name of the root user created on first start (in the admin database)

rootpassword.desc: Password of the root user. Only applied when the database is created

extraargs.desc: Optional. Extra command line options for the server, for example --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB 0.5

run.command: bash -c "set -e; mkdir -p /SkyPanel/data; if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ]; then find /SkyPanel/data \\! -user mongodb -exec chown mongodb:mongodb '{}' +; fi; exec docker-entrypoint.sh mongod --dbpath /SkyPanel/data --port ${port} --bind_ip_all ${extraargs}"
